title: SignatureTooShort error variant misleads for oversized signatures
description: core/src/group_log/verify.rs: the check_signature function uses try_into() to coerce the operator_signature bytes into a [u8; 64]. The error variant name SignatureTooShort applies to all length-mismatch cases, including too-long (e.g., 65+ bytes). An operator debugging a malformed log entry sees SignatureTooShort in the error but the message also prints the actual length which may be > 64. The variant name is misleading. Suggested rewrite: rename to SignatureLengthInvalid { got: usize, expected: usize } to accurately represent both too-short and too-long cases.
